[Verse 1]
[C#5]Broken, bones and the will.
Capacity to
disappear in misery saves.
Soaking, pain is a thrill,
hate to instill.
Com-
passion's a cage.

[Chorus]
[A5]Forgiving the fa-
[F#5]ther. Read the sto-

[C#5]

[C#5]again.

[Verse 2]
[C#5]Sunken, sooner or la-
ter we crawl our way back
Into our favorite hole.
Drunken, swallow the sa-
vior. And follow him to
hang from the highest pole.

[F#5]tyr.

again.

again.
This is where the end
begins.
